method: Native editable PowerPoint vector diagram authored with @oai/artifact-tool
interpretation: Conceptual architecture. One shared encoder/joint actor emits one complete coupled action before environment feedback. REINFORCE updates at episode end. Four chiplets, neural-layer counts, highlighted links, and PPA bar levels are illustrative. Hardware inset simplifies the data path and omits the vector unit, not a complete RTL wiring diagram. The action compute-count range remains 1–16.
